text: readable-diagrams 是面向 DSH 及其他可读取 SKILL.md 的 agent 的图表制作技能：在 DSH 中注册后，agent 可按 JSON 规范生成独立 HTML 图页。它支持架构、流程、状态、时序、时间线、树形、分层、条形图和象限图，也提供 Mermaid、draw.io、Excalidraw 内容提取及 SVG、PNG 导出。页面配有标题、结论摘要、阅读路径、图例和说明，并可用结构及可读性检查器验证。适合需要把系统、流程或比较关系整理成易读图页的使用者；不需要 API Key，运行脚本需 Python 3.9+，DSH 包装器需 Node.js 20+。

readable-diagrams adds a diagram skill to DSH. It renders JSON specs as standalone HTML for architecture, flow, sequence and charts. It imports Mermaid, draw.io and Excalidraw, checks readability, and exports SVG or PNG. Scripts need Python 3.9+; PNG export uses Chrome or Chromium.
想把系统组件和它们之间的关系整理成一张容易读懂的架构图。
有没有办法从 JSON 规范直接生成带说明的流程图网页？
让 agent 画出的图也带上结论、阅读顺序和图注。
手头有 Mermaid 流程，想保留节点关系并重新排成清晰的图。
需要将已有 draw.io 或 Excalidraw 图的内容转换成新的 HTML 图页。
我想检查生成的图有没有标题、说明、可访问 SVG 和足够的文字对比度。
I need to turn a JSON diagram spec into a self-contained HTML page.
Can I extract the structure of a Mermaid diagram and redraw it with a consistent visual style?
readable-diagrams 的功能「规范渲染」：把 JSON 图表规范转换为独立 HTML 页面。通过 render.py 输入规范文件，可生成架构、流程、时序、时间线等结构图。
readable-diagrams 的功能「图表检查」：对生成页面运行结构与理解度检查，核对 SVG 可访问信息、标题、摘要、阅读路径、文字尺寸和对比度等要求。
readable-diagrams 的功能「现有图表导入」：用提取脚本读取 Mermaid、draw.io 或 Excalidraw 文件中的图形内容，再依据规范重新绘制为统一样式。
readable-diagrams 的功能「图像导出」：对已生成的 HTML 图页调用 export.py，可提取 SVG 或通过本机 Chrome/Chromium 导出 PNG。

dsh-readable-diagrams README · Why this exists：Two excellent skills already exist, and they solve different halves of the problem:

dsh-readable-diagrams README · Why this exists：| Layer | Comes from | What it gives |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Validated spec pipeline | [Archify](https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify) (Apache-2.0) | JSON intermediate → deterministic render → gates |
| Editorial design system | [diagram-design](https://github.com/cathrynlavery/diagram-design) (MIT) | paper/ink/accent tokens, type ramp, orthogonal connectors, accessible SVG |
| **Comprehension contract** | this project | conclusion title, takeaway, numbered reading path, legend, caption — **and a checker that fails the page when they are missing** |

dsh-readable-diagrams README · Why this exists：Neither parent validates that a human can *read* the result. That is the point of
this skill: the page is not allowed to ship unless the reading furniture is there,
the accent budget holds, contrast clears 4.5:1, and the connectors are orthogonal.

dsh-readable-diagrams README · What you get：- **Nine spec-driven types** — architecture, flow, state, sequence, timeline,
  tree, layer stack, bar, quadrant.
- **Chart families by hand** — line, scatter, sankey, radar, heatmap, Gantt, Venn,
  funnel, journey… drawn against the same furniture and the same gates.
- **Two gates, both must pass** — `self_check.py` (structure, accessibility,
  single-file safety) and `comprehension_check.py` (readability).
- **Hover interaction, no JavaScript** — hovering a node dims the rest and lights
  its edges (shown above); hovering a reading step lights its node; staggered
  entrance; reduced-motion and print fall back to the static frame.
- **Editorial skins** — light + dark, CJK-aware typography (12px floor, register
  switch for Chinese labels), 4px grid, no shadows.
- **Import / export** — Mermaid, draw.io and Excalidraw in; SVG and PNG out.
- **Eight example pages** in [`skills/readable-diagrams/examples/`](skills/readable-diagrams/examples/),
  each passing both gates.

dsh-readable-diagrams README · The two gates：```text
comprehension_check.py   title ≤60 · takeaway · caption · numbered reading path ·
                         legend coverage · ≤2 focal accents · node budget ·
                         edge-label coverage · type floors · contrast ·
                         orthogonal connectors · accessible SVG exists

A non-zero exit is never success. Failures are ordinary evidence: fix the spec,
regenerate, rerun. Generated HTML is never hand-patched.

dsh-readable-diagrams README · Install：| Host | Install |
| --- | --- |
| **DeepSeek Harness** | Add this repo as a plugin: `dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/bingomu/readable-diagrams/archive/refs/tags/v1.1.0.tar.gz` — or the **Plugins → Add** page with the same URL. Restart the app; the skill appears in the session catalogue. |
| **Claude Code** | `/plugin marketplace add bingomu/readable-diagrams`, then install `readable-diagrams` — or copy `skills/readable-diagrams/` to `~/.claude/skills/`. |
| **Codex** | Copy `skills/readable-diagrams/` to `~/.codex/skills/`, or point Codex at the repo’s `.codex-plugin/` manifest. |
| **Any agent that reads `SKILL.md`** | `bash install.sh` (copies the skill folder to `~/.agents/skills/`). |

dsh-readable-diagrams README · Install：Every host installs from this repo — no npm package is required. (The DSH in-app
market index only lists npm-published plugins, so appearing inside Discover /
dshmarket needs an npm release; direct installs work regardless.) No build step
and no runtime dependencies either: Python 3.9+ for the scripts, Node 20+ only
for the DSH plugin wrapper.
